name: Log & Exp Functions
roadmap: Master the laws of indices and logarithms first. Then, learn how to solve exponential and logarithmic equations using substitution. Finally, conquer the linearization of curves into straight lines, a core HKDSE concept.
roadmap_zh: 首先掌握指數與對數定律。然後，學習如何利用代換法解指數與對數方程。最後，征服將曲線線性化為直線的技巧，這是 HKDSE 的核心概念。

concepts.name: Laws of Logarithms
concepts.key_takeaway:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Rule 1: Product Rule**
> $\log_a (xy) = \log_a x + \log_a y$
> 
> **Rule 2: Quotient Rule**
> $\log_a \left(\frac{x}{y}\right) = \log_a x - \log_a y$
> 
> **Rule 3: Power Rule**
> $\log_a (x^n) = n \log_a x$
concepts.key_takeaway_zh:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> **法則 1：積法則**
> $\log_a (xy) = \log_a x + \log_a y$
> 
> **法則 2：商法則**
> $\log_a \left(\frac{x}{y}\right) = \log_a x - \log_a y$
> 
> **法則 3：冪法則**
> $\log_a (x^n) = n \log_a x$

concepts.name: Exponential Graphs
concepts.key_takeaway: Exponential curves never touch the x-axis ($y=0$). If $a>1$, it's growth; if $0<a<1$, it's decay.
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 指數曲線永遠不會接觸 x 軸 ($y=0$)。當 $a>1$ 時為增長；當 $0<a<1$ 時為衰減。

concepts.name: Logarithmic Graphs
concepts.key_takeaway: Log graphs are reflections of exponential graphs along $y=x$. They have a vertical asymptote at $x=0$.
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 對數圖像是指數圖像沿 $y=x$ 的反射。它們在 $x=0$ 處有一條垂直漸近線。

concepts.name: Substitution Method
concepts.key_takeaway: Transform complex equations into simple quadratics using $u = a^x$. Remember to reject $u \le 0$.
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 利用 $u = a^x$ 將複雜方程轉化為簡單二次方程。記得捨去 $u \le 0$ 的解。

concepts.name: Linearizing $y = ab^x$
concepts.key_takeaway: Take $\log$ on both sides to get a line of $\log y$ against $x$. Slope is $\log b$ and y-intercept is $\log a$.
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 兩邊取 $\log$ 得到 $\log y$ 對 $x$ 的直線。斜率為 $\log b$，y-截距為 $\log a$。

concepts.name: Linearizing $y = ax^n$
concepts.key_takeaway: Take $\log$ on both sides to get a line of $\log y$ against $\log x$. Slope is $n$ and y-intercept is $\log a$.
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 兩邊取 $\log$ 得到 $\log y$ 對 $\log x$ 的直線。斜率為 $n$，y-截距為 $\log a$。
